entry.title: Liminal Hz 1.5.0
entry.summary: Real rooms, halls and echoes from impulse responses (up to 5 s, mono or stereo), the space for your NAM amp; ~3.5% of an audio block on a Force; browses reverbs/ folders and TONE3000.

entry.title: πToniC 1.2.0
entry.summary: πToniC is an 8-voice drum machine for Force and MPC, inspired by Microtonic. Each voice combines noise with synth, wavetable or sample playback, plus modulation, EQ and effects. Includes 150 Patternarium BEST kits, Microtonic .mtpreset import, and matching A+B patterns in the πClideaN MIDI sequencer.

entry.title: Tropix 0.2.0
entry.summary: Island and afro ROMpler: 128 presets and 65 instruments for afrobeat, amapiano, kompa, soca, reggae and Hawaiian music - steel pans, log drums, saxes and trumpets, kompa and slack-key guitars, steels, keys, mallets, basses and percussion. Two layers, glide, horn scoop, vibrato, nine colorways. Also a VST3 (Mac, Windows) and Mac AU.

entry.title: TREEGONE 1.0.10
entry.summary: A Trigon-6-style 6- or 12-voice poly: three oscillators with blended shapes, sync, osc 3 LO, noise, feedback and drive, three filters (4-pole OTA, ladder, 2-pole SVF), two ADSRs, audio-rate LFO, poly mod, vintage, distortion, two effects, unison with chord memory, arp and poly sequencer. ECO and HIGH quality. Panel-style touch pages.

entry.title: Sonix 0.4.0
entry.summary: A melodic ROMpler instrument for standalone Akai MPC devices, built as a native ARM VST2 plugin. Includes pianos, keys, pads, strings, brass, choirs, leads, plucks, bass, bells, synth chords and effects, using redistributable sound libraries. Also a VST3 for Mac and Windows and an Audio Unit for Mac.

entry.title: SILICON 1.0.1
entry.summary: MPC OS 3.x ARM32 four-layer FM synthesizer with four selectable FM engines.

entry.title: Schwung ports: 6 plugins updated
entry.summary: HUSH ONE 0.2.8, Junologue Chorus 0.1.2, Midiverb 0.3.0, PSX Verb 0.5.3, TapeDelay 2.0.1, TAPESCAM 0.5.5

entry.title: Revvy85 0.4.0
entry.summary: REV7-style 1985 digital reverb: an emulated HD6303 and YM3804 machine running your own V1.0 EPROM dump (not included), with the original programs, keys, display and memories, plus HP/LP and SEM-style input filters. Gen2 (aarch64) only.

entry.title: REEVES 1.1.4
entry.summary: A Rev2-style bi-timbral poly, 8 or 16 voices: two shape-modulated oscillators, sub, noise, sync, a 4-pole/2-pole low-pass, three envelopes, four LFOs, eight mod slots, an effect per layer, arp, poly and gated sequencers, unison, stack and split. ECO and HIGH quality. Panel-style touch pages per layer.

entry.title: REEVES 1.1.3
entry.summary: A Rev2-style bi-timbral poly, 8 or 16 voices: two shape-modulated oscillators, sub, noise, sync, a 4-pole/2-pole low-pass, three envelopes, four LFOs, eight mod slots, an effect per layer, arp, poly and gated sequencers, unison, stack and split. ECO and HIGH quality. Panel-style touch pages per layer.

entry.title: PROPHETIC 6 1.0.8
entry.summary: A port of the PROPHET 67 firmware for the M-VAVE FM-1: a Prophet-6-style 7-voice analogue poly with two oscillators (sub, noise, sync, poly mod), a high-pass into a resonant 4-pole low-pass, two LFOs, distortion, chorus, delay, five reverbs, an arp on the MPC tempo and a low split. HIGH and ECO quality for the CPU. Panel-style touch pages.

entry.title: Poli effects: 13 plugins updated
entry.summary: Poli-Chorus 1.0.0, Poli-delay 1.0.2, Poli-Ess 1.0.6, Poli-Juicebox 1.5.0, Poli-Multiband 1.2.4, Poli-q 1.1.2, Poli-Saturator 1.0.0, Poli-tea 1.0.1, Poli-verb 1.0.3, PoliPlug 1.5.3, PoliPlug 1.5.2, Poliwow 1.3.0, Shhhhh 1.0.4

entry.title: PEEK 1.0.6
entry.summary: A Peak-style 8- or 16-voice hybrid poly: three oscillators with shape, VSync, saw density and 60 wavetables, linear FM, ring mod and noise, a 12/24 dB LP/BP/HP filter between two drives, three looping envelopes, four LFOs, a 16-slot mod matrix and 4-slot FX matrix, arp, distortion, chorus, delay and reverb. ECO and HIGH quality.

entry.title: OxZygen 0.8.2
entry.summary: A dark, cinematic instrument: choirs, winds, brass, strings, bells, keys, mallets, synths and textures from CC0 recordings, in two layered slots with filter, lo-fi, tempo-synced delay and motion, reverb and sub. 200 presets; a metal-chamber screen whose vents glow as you play, in five themes. Also a VST3 for Mac and Windows and an AU for Mac.

entry.title: Ondes 0.5.0
entry.summary: Ondes Martenot-style instrument for MPC OS 3.x: eight combinable timbres, an intensity key (pedal, aftertouch or velocity), ribbon mode with hold for the touch strip, hand vibrato, transposition buttons, Legato/Mono/Poly voices and presets in the PRESET field. Tested on an MPC Key 61 (MPC OS 3.10.1).

entry.title: MD Glitch 0.2.5 (beta)
entry.summary: A failing portable disc recorder: a low-bitrate transform codec with up to eight re-encodes, an anti-skip buffer that stutters, drops out and jumps (Bump and Freeze keys), and a digital input with clock slips and bit errors. Live display skin. Gens 6-8 add up to 46 ms of latency, best on playback tracks.

entry.title: Ju-08 1.1.0
entry.summary: A Jupiter-8 style polysynth: two parts of four voices (or eight on one patch), two VCOs with sync and cross mod, HPF, 12/24 dB VCF, two envelopes, LFO, arpeggiator, 17 chorus and multi-effects, delay, reverb with shimmer, 64 patches. Built with the Akai MPC Plugin SDK; Gen1 and Gen2.

entry.title: FAKE5 1.0.7
entry.summary: A Take-5-style 5- or 10-voice poly: two oscillators with continuous shape, sub, noise, sync and linear FM 2>1, a driven 4-pole low-pass, two DADSR envelopes, two LFOs, sixteen mod slots on a display page, vintage, overdrive, voice spread, twelve effects and a plate reverb, arp and 64-step sequencer. ECO and HIGH quality. Panel-style touch pages.

entry.title: FAKE5 1.0.6
entry.summary: A Take-5-style 5- or 10-voice poly: two oscillators with continuous shape, sub, noise, sync and linear FM 2>1, a driven 4-pole low-pass, two DADSR envelopes, two LFOs, sixteen mod slots on a display page, vintage, overdrive, voice spread, twelve effects and a plate reverb, arp and 64-step sequencer. entry.title: DUST '87 0.1.0
entry.summary: 18-voice procedural drum machine with an MPC-synced 64-step sequencer, 80 built-in grooves, and lo-fi sample-rate and bit-depth reduction.

entry.title: Driftwater 1.0.1
entry.summary: Give guitar, keys or drums a gently drifting stereo wobble. Rate, Damp and Depth shape the motion, LPG lets transients brighten the wet signal, and Mix blends the effect with the dry input. An homage to the Fairfield Circuitry Shallow Water.

entry.title: ARIA 1.3.3
entry.summary: The MPC version of the ARIA VST3: an 8-voice bi-timbral analogue-modelling poly. Two oscillators with wave mix, FM and sync, a mod osc per voice, two ladder filters (series, stereo or parallel), looping envelopes, a chord memory with a chord on every key, an arp with a 16-step pattern, a low split and a diffusion delay. Panel-style touch pages.

entry.title: Warpline 1.3.0
entry.summary: Wavetable synth for standalone MPC built on the open-source Vital engine: plays .vital patches (add your own in <drive>/Warpline/Patches), 519 factory patches in 11 genres incl. rage, UK garage, DnB and jungle, with search and favourites, a wavetable picker, a generative 16-step arpeggiator, GRAINZ granular FX and a mod matrix with random sources.

entry.title: Tuner 1.1.4
entry.summary: A chromatic tuner insert with a live needle drawn straight onto the MPC's screen at 20-24 fps: note, cents and Hz, A4 from 430 to 450 Hz, and a mute for silent tuning. It writes into MPC's display memory, which MPC OS doesn't offer plugins, so a firmware update could break it. Not affiliated with Akai.

entry.title: Tributary 1.3.0
entry.summary: Sums chosen Elektron Overbridge outputs onto one MPC track over USB. The machine is 48 kHz; the track resamples that to the MPC's 44.1. Capture saves the machine's own 48 kHz samples, locked to the bars. Based on Overwitch.

entry.title: Stompbox 1.1.3
entry.summary: A whole guitar rig from guitarix's DSP: gate, comp, wah, any number of pedals, amp, tone stack, power amp, cabinet with an IR loader, post FX, mod, delay, reverb and EQ. 219 models and guitarix's 40 factory presets in the PRESET menu. Not affiliated with guitarix.

entry.title: Prophetic 0.1.1
entry.summary: The Korg Prophecy's synthesis, built on your computer from your own Prophecy v2.0 ROMs: their DSP programs and sound-engine firmware, translated to C++. 128 programs, every parameter, Performance Editor, arpeggiator, 1-8 voices. Gen2; tested on an MPC Live III.

entry.summary: CZ-style phase distortion synth, from glassy sines to classic saws, with 32 factory presets. Built on Leo Kuroshita's CrispyZebra engine.
